The Linux host tools ship inside the app. To provide a complete Linux environment, AkaTerminal downloads the Ubuntu rootfs directly from GitHub Releases when you continue. It is not bundled in the F-Droid APK:
Initialize the local embedded Linux prefix, PulseAudio server, and terminal toolchain before Ubuntu is installed.
I understand this setup downloads the Ubuntu rootfs from GitHub Releases. That archive is not in the base APK and is not checked by F-Droid.
